name: A City One Plank Deep
prompt: Stand five ornate house facades in a narrowing fan. From one little camera they form a convincing grand street; from above their timber braces and back doors are exposed. An actor passes from a palace straight into a prop cupboard.

name: The Sea in a Drawer
prompt: Make a giant blue drawer pulled halfway out of a brick soundstage. A crank beneath its base rocks painted wooden waves around a tiny storm-tossed boat. Stagehands tip a watering can through a perforated cloud.

name: The Shadow Catering Unit
prompt: Set a broad lemon-coloured screen behind a mess table covered with ordinary cutlery. A projector turns the cutlery into a skyline of fantastic towers. Stagehands lift a single fork to open a route for a shadow train.

name: Mountains by the Metre
prompt: Wind a long painted mountain panorama onto upright drums at either end of a narrow track. An actor pedals a stationary red bicycle while crews move different layers at different speeds. One partly rolled peak shows bare canvas on its reverse.

name: The Rain Falls Sideways
prompt: Turn a full domestic interior on its side so a table and chairs cling to one upright wall. An actor lies against a painted door. A row of watering heads sends rain across the whole tilted set toward the camera.
